semantics.equivalence_rule: Equivalent accepted snapshot yields semantically equivalent normalized graphs regardless of local/package carrier.
semantics.bootstrap_rule: Both modes use the same Contract Format version/profile semantics.
semantics.identity_rule: Physical carrier/path differences do not change canonical identity.
semantics.manifest_rule: Package manifests preserve the source set and role information required to reproduce local semantics.
semantics.failure_rule: Any local/package graph divergence for the same accepted snapshot is a conformance failure.

invariants.rule: Canonical source resolution is deterministic, exact-identity based and provenance-preserving; filesystem location, transport or freshness never silently changes semantic authority.
